description: Detect Technologies, Bulk Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/website-tech-stack-detector.

datasetField.description: Optional. The item field that holds the value, for example website, url or videoUrl (dot paths like author.url work). Empty = detected automatically.

datasetId.description: Optional. Pick a dataset (or paste its ID) to read the input from, for example the result of Google Maps Scraper. When this actor runs as an integration, the dataset of the triggering run is used automatically (payload.resource.defaultDatas

datasetMaxItems.description: Upper limit of unique values taken from the dataset, to keep the cost under control.

domains.description: Company websites to analyse, for example shopify.com, stripe.com or https://www.hubspot.com. Bare domains and full URLs are accepted; the homepage is fetched once per site. If left empty, five example sites are used.

includeCompanyInfo.description: Add the page title, meta description, the company's own social profile links found on the homepage (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub) and the generator meta tag.

includeDns.description: Also read the domain's MX and TXT records (via DNS) to detect the email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, ...) and SPF senders.

maxConcurrency.description: How many websites are fetched in parallel. 10 is polite; lower it if sites rate-limit you.

minConfidence.description: Only report technologies detected with at least this confidence (0-100). 50 hides weak single-signal guesses; use 100 for the strictest list.

name: website_tech_stack_detector
title: Tech Stack Lookup API - Detect Technologies, Bulk
